messages:
Ivy (Product): Quick micro-review of the Private setup wizard 'Connection checks' step. Noticed layout breakage on narrow viewports and some terse copy that confused our test users. Recording: https://redwood.design/s/conn-mini
Ravi (Design): On small widths the 3-column status table wraps and hides the action buttons. Propose a compact list: icon, short label, status pill, chevron to expand details. Keep primary CTA visible.
Hana (Engineering): Implementation note: make each row a single flex line with .detail { min-width:0 } and truncate hostnames. Collapse logs by default, show last 4 lines with 'Show full log'. CSS snippet: `.log-preview{max-height:96px;overflow:hidden}`
Mika (Accessibility): Make rows real buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When expanded, move focus to the panel header and provide a visually-hidden summary that updates via aria-live="polite" (debounced ~250ms) to announce probe results. Don't steal focus for minor flicker.
Sam (PM): Copy suggestions: replace terse errors with action-first phrasing. E.g. 'SSH (port 22) blocked  Check host firewall or security group' and change 'Skipped' to 'Not required for your configuration' with a tooltip explaining why. Primary CTA should read 'Continue setup' and retry be secondary.
Ravi (Design): Chip contrast: add a 1px outline in dark theme and increase text weight to meet 4.5:1. Also add an inline help link 'Troubleshoot host reachability' to KB.
Hana (Engineering): I'll debounce UI updates and add a small e2e that asserts the live region contains "All probes complete" before enabling Continue. Will also ensure expand/collapse works with Enter/Space.
Ivy (Product): Acceptance checklist I'll add to the ticket: compact list <=480px, collapsed logs with accessible expand, aria-live summary debounced, keyboard-toggle rows with aria-expanded, chip contrast AA in both themes, microcopy updated. Post Figma + demo link here when ready.
